newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end flat, wait for Cimpor.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end flat, wait for Cimpor.

text.p: 1605 GMT - Shares closed flat with little news to stimulate trade as investors awaited the results of the Cimpor privatisation due on Tuesday. The partial financial holiday in the U.S. was adding to the sense of calm, traders said.
*The .PSI20 index ended 0.01 percent up with overall cash trade a mere 1.8 billion escudos. Futures were slightly firmer.
*Ship repairer Lisnave rose three percent to 419 escudos in trade of some 86,000 shares after the government gave the loss-making concern a six billion escudo guarantee.
*Cimpor rose 0.71 percent to 3,278 escudos. Analysts expect the price at the privatisation to be around 3,200 escudos.
